mainEntity.name: Can I hire you just for motel deal sourcing and underwriting, and what do I receive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer sourcing and underwriting separately, without requiring a management agreement. You receive market analysis, operating budgets, pro formas, an asset plan and a property underwriting model. Fees are confirmed in writing before work, per mandate: a retainer, success fee payable at closing, or both, depending on scope and complexity. You may choose any operator after closing; hiring us to operate requires a separate management agreement.

mainEntity.name: Can you optimize pricing and inventory while preserving corporate rates, group allotments and distribution commitments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we preserve your existing corporate and tour operator contracts, including fixed rates, room allotments and release dates, without requiring renegotiation. We price the remaining inventory around those commitments, release unused allotments for public sale on their release dates and flag contracts worth reviewing at renewal.

mainEntity.name: Will reports link campaign spend to completed bookings and acquisition cost, not just traffic or revenue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, our reports connect campaign spend with completed reservations and show the acquisition cost per booking for each channel. We set up tracking in your booking engine to attribute reservations and their booking value to campaigns, rather than reporting only traffic or gross revenue.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep my QuickBooks and my accountant, or do you move everything to your platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can keep your accountant and use QuickBooks for year-end and tax work, and we handle your daily bookkeeping in the systems we agree with you. We export your ledger to QuickBooks monthly, and your accountant retains full access to ledgers, bank reconciliations and supporting documents. You can hire us for accounting alone.

mainEntity.name: What keeps reservations and guest operations running during internet, PMS or channel manager outages?

acceptedAnswer.text: We hold or close OTA inventory through the channel manager or extranets to prevent overbookings, while your front desk uses offline arrivals and room status reports updated nightly. In our business hours, we escalate the outage to your vendors as soon as we see it; outside them, your front desk keeps the fallback going and we pick it up the next business day. Once systems return, we re-sync all reservations, normally within 2 business hours.

hero.heading: Motel Business Development, from Deal Sourcing to Opening Day
lead: We bring you motel deals worth pursuing, on and off market, in the US, Canada, France and Australia.

cta.label: Talk to us about business development

blocks.heading: Business Development for Your Motel Portfolio
paragraphs: Our motel business development finds on- and off-market motel investment opportunities for you in the United States, Canada, France, Australia and the other countries where we work with owners. We look at where value can be added through better operations, rebranding or renovation, and we give you lead-generation sources that keep new deals and motel business coming your way.

blocks.heading: Off-Market Deal Sourcing and Due Diligence

items.heading: Sourcing and screening
paragraphs: Our network of hospitality owners brings us off-market targets, and we look at listings as well. We screen the market and its position in the cycle first, then the operations, using supply, demand, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR projections and competitive-set rates. You only see assets that pass both screens.

items.heading: Remote document review
paragraphs: We go through the P&Ls, rate and booking history, franchise and management agreements, vendor contracts and PIP documents. We check operations through scheduled video walkthroughs.

items.heading: Independent site inspections
paragraphs: Property condition, engineering, environmental and code inspections need professionals on site. We commission an independent local inspector or engineer, or work with the one your team appoints. We go through their report with you within 5 business days.

items.heading: Acquisition diligence report
paragraphs: For every acquisition we assess, you get a report covering local market trends, historical earnings and realistic earnings potential. It also includes a financial model projecting future results.

items.heading: Obligations and competitive position
paragraphs: Your diligence report looks at the management contract, franchise affiliation, competitive position, property improvement plan obligations and capital expenditure requirements.

items.heading: Priced risks and decisions
paragraphs: Every red flag comes with an estimated cost to fix it and our recommendation to either negotiate a lower price or walk away. The report ends with the acquisition risks, the unresolved issues and the conditions you need to meet before going ahead.

items.heading: Pre-closing team review
paragraphs: Before you close, our operations and sales teams remotely assess current operations, staffing, rate strategy and channel mix. They also review vendor, franchise and management contracts and your PIP and capital exposure.

items.heading: Written asset review
paragraphs: Within 10 business days of getting access to the seller's operating reports and data room, we send you the asset review report, which sets out prioritised risks and upside opportunities.

blocks.heading: Who We Work With and How Mandates Work

items.heading: Who we support
paragraphs: Our business development for motels and hotels serves both first-time investors and portfolio owners, and acquisitions have no minimum deal size or room count.

items.heading: Mandate arrangements
paragraphs: Sourcing is non-exclusive by default. If you prefer, it can be exclusive for one market for 6 months. You choose the arrangement for your mandate.

items.heading: Competing client interests
paragraphs: When a deal suits several clients, we present it to them in the order they signed their mandates. We never advise two clients bidding on the same asset.

items.heading: Your starting documents
paragraphs: Send us your markets, room count, budget, target returns, proof of funds or a lender letter, your diligence team's contacts and a signed NDA. If you're a first-time investor, clear information lets us quickly find deals you can realistically close.

items.heading: Transaction experience
paragraphs: Since 2016, we've sourced, underwritten or supported 15 acquisitions and sales involving independent motels and hotels of 20 to 250 rooms. Before you sign, you can ask for an anonymised transaction list showing property types, sizes and our roles.

items.heading: Investment assessment
items.text: We look for upside in expanding your portfolio or repositioning. We underwrite each opportunity with market analysis, operating proformas and budgets.

items.heading: Downside-led decisions
items.text: We judge a deal by how well it holds up on the downside. Every model tests occupancy and ADR at 10% to 20% below the base case.

items.heading: Cost and financing stress
items.text: Every model also tests renovation costs 15% over budget, interest rates 200 basis points higher and exit cap rates 50 to 100 basis points wider.

items.heading: Return and coverage effects
items.text: For each downside case, you see its effect on IRR, cash-on-cash return and debt service coverage.

items.heading: Working underwriting package
items.text: Within 10 business days of receiving the offering materials and data, we deliver the complete underwriting, an Excel investment model with open formulas and a PDF investment summary.

items.heading: Your advisers involved
items.text: We work alongside your lender, broker and lawyers, and your team gets a working model to test its own assumptions.

items.heading: Under-contract and refinancing support
items.text: If a deal is already under contract, we take it on for underwriting and diligence only. We also support refinancing for motels and hotels you already own.

items.heading: Focused assignment scope
items.text: These assignments cover market performance trends, historical and achievable operating results, forecasts, and reviews of existing management and franchise agreements.

blocks.heading: Debt and Equity Financing and Exit Strategy

items.heading: Licensed partner delivery
paragraphs: We don't hold a real estate or mortgage broker licence. When placing debt or searching for buyers requires one, we direct licensed partner brokers in the relevant US state, Canadian province, France or Australia.

items.heading: Debt and equity
paragraphs: We've helped investors raise both debt and equity. For acquisitions and development, the lenders we introduce you to include local and national banks, SBA lenders for US deals, CMBS, debt funds, bridge lenders and construction lenders. We don't lend money ourselves.

items.heading: Financing through closing
paragraphs: We put together your financing package and compare term sheets on total cost, covenants and flexibility, not just the headline rate. We support you through negotiations right up to closing, and our development support continues once you've chosen the motel.

items.heading: Exit planning
paragraphs: We plan your exit at the same time as your financing. When you're ready to sell, we find buyers for the asset.

items.heading: Brand selection
items.text: We judge each flag by its net effect on your results, weighing local demand against fees, PIP requirements and contract terms. Then we negotiate your franchise agreement.

items.heading: Product positioning
items.text: We set your motel's positioning. When an existing property needs a new direction, we handle the repositioning and rebranding.

items.heading: Conversion timing
items.text: While your current franchise is still in force, we plan the conversion and negotiate the new agreement, and we time PIP delivery to match your exit date.

items.heading: Legal responsibilities
items.text: Your counsel handles termination notices, liquidated damages, settlements with the outgoing brand and the legal review of the new licence agreement.

items.heading: Counsel coordination
items.text: We give your legal team the brand timeline, PIP costs and rate data it needs for that work.

blocks.heading: Design Review and Property Improvement Plans
paragraphs: Before construction starts, we review the design and architecture, and we price and manage your property improvement plan. Your written review checks the layout, back-of-house areas, room mix, building systems and FF&E specifications against brand standards, operating flow and guest experience. Every finding comes with a priority, a recommended change, an estimated cost and its operating impact, so you deal with the most consequential issues before you build. You get the first report within 10 business days of us receiving the drawings, and we review revised sets within 5 business days.

items.heading: Project delivery and purchasing
paragraphs: Our [project management](/project-management/) covers FF&E procurement and oversight of delivery. You get monthly reports and weekly updates. Any forecast more than 5% over a budget line needs approval. We complete takeover reviews within 10 business days of receiving the project documents.

items.heading: Team and opening preparation
paragraphs: Our [motel management support](/) coordinates the designers and consultants your project requires, franchisor and manager document checks, communication with the construction team, change-order and schedule decisions, and pre-opening budgets, procurement and marketing.

blocks.heading: Construction Oversight and Site Reporting
paragraphs: We don't attend the property, so daily site supervision is handled by your general contractor's site superintendent or the owner's representative you appoint. We need their detailed daily logs, photos and weekly video walkthroughs so we can review the work remotely, and we raise any issues with you within 3 business days.

items.heading: Annual marketing plan
items.text: Before you open, we prepare your motel's annual marketing plan, which sets the commercial plan for your launch.

items.heading: Budget and revenue execution
items.text: We prepare your operating budget before opening and put your revenue strategy into action from day one.

items.heading: Motel staff recruitment
items.text: We recruit and hire your motel's staff through our [human resources service](/human-resources/).

blocks.heading: Deal Services Priced per Mandate
paragraphs: We price sourcing, underwriting, debt sourcing and buyer search for each mandate, and we agree the fees with you in writing before any work begins. Fees are set by the size and complexity of your brief. Fixed work is on a retainer, work with uncertain results has a larger success component, and some briefs use a mix of the two. Success fees are paid when the deal completes.

blocks.heading: Fixed Fees for Development Work
paragraphs: Before you sign, we quote [development work](/development/) based on its scope. The quote is either a fixed project fee or a monthly retainer for the months the work runs, and it's never a percentage of your pre-opening or FF&E budgets. Suppliers contract directly with your ownership entity at their own prices, so there's no resale and no mark-up, and we earn nothing from what you spend.

hero.heading: Motel Digital Marketing That Drives Direct Bookings
lead: Your motel shows up on Google, trivago, TripAdvisor and Kayak with rates that lead to your website.

cta.label: Talk to us about digital marketing

blocks.heading: Digital marketing services that bring rate shoppers to your own website
paragraphs: When guests decide where to click, your own booking link is up against OTA offers. Our motel digital marketing builds your online presence on Google, trivago, TripAdvisor and Kayak. We link rate visibility, your booking website and your guest reputation so bookings come straight to you.

blocks.heading: Free booking links, Hotel Ads and a live rate feed

items.heading: Free links first
paragraphs: Before we recommend any paid advertising, we connect and verify your feed. Google's free booking links show your direct rate at no charge, and they start appearing a few days after verification.

items.heading: Paid campaign readiness
paragraphs: Free links let us check how accurate and competitive your feed is without spending anything. Paid clicks are only worth buying once your feed is accurate and your rate matches or beats the OTAs.

items.heading: Google paid campaigns
paragraphs: We maintain your metasearch listings. We run paid placements only on Google Hotel Ads, not on trivago, TripAdvisor or Kayak.

items.heading: Live rate connection
paragraphs: Your booking engine or channel manager has to supply live rates and availability. We connect that feed or check the connection you already have.

items.heading: Incompatible booking engines
paragraphs: If your engine can't send live rates, we talk with you about routing through a channel manager or switching to a compatible engine before any extra costs come up. You don't need to rebuild your website.

items.heading: Connectivity charges
paragraphs: On top of your advertising spend, your provider's feed or connectivity charges are billed to your property at cost, with no mark-up from us.

items.heading: Agency handover
paragraphs: We take over your existing campaigns through a structured transfer of your accounts, listings, advertising accounts, creative assets and performance data.

blocks.heading: A Google Business Profile built for motel search filters

items.heading: Ownership first
items.text: We fix any control problems before we start on the profile. If your motel doesn't control the account, you lose any improvements made on it.

items.heading: Transfers and reinstatement
items.text: We request ownership through Google, merge or remove duplicate listings, and appeal suspensions with the required business documents. That way, verification sits under your own Google account.

items.heading: Complete motel details
items.text: We fill in your rooms, amenities, categories, descriptions, and accessibility and sustainability attributes. Missing information keeps a property out of the relevant hotel filters and rankings.

items.heading: One coordinated pass
items.text: We handle content, settings, visuals and trust signals together. That covers the profile signals Google documents for hotel listings, instead of fixing fields one at a time.

items.heading: Photos and activity
items.text: We put your profile photos in a deliberate order, caption every image, and set up questions, answers and profile posts.

items.heading: English and French
items.text: We write your listings and review replies in English or French. If your motel is in France or Quebec, you get French content and replies.

blocks.heading: A direct rate that stays accurate, competitive and in parity

items.heading: Competitive direct rates
paragraphs: We correct your direct rate before you spend anything on metasearch. Then we check OTA parity after setup and again at your 30-day review.

items.heading: Value beyond parity
paragraphs: If your rate only matches the OTAs or loses to them, a paid click is wasted. So we recommend member rates or perks that give guests better value while staying within your OTA contracts.

items.heading: Revenue issue resolution

items.heading: Booking flow checks

items.heading: Consent before tracking
paragraphs: Conversion tracking starts only after a visitor gives consent. We use a consent banner and Google's consent mode, in line with the GDPR.

items.heading: French data hosting

paragraphs: We deduplicate by reservation number, reconcile the totals with your PMS every month, and take out cancelled and refunded reservations. That way, each qualifying booking counts once.

items.heading: Publication under your control

items.heading: Serious complaint escalation

items.heading: Personal complaint responses

items.heading: Outsourced OTA management

items.heading: Photographer coordination

items.heading: Consistent image sets
paragraphs: We upload the same on-brand images to your website and your OTA listings, and we follow your brand-specific guidelines on every platform.

blocks.heading: Sales, marketing and reputation working as one

hero.heading: Motel Human Resources Services for Your Property
lead: You keep the final say on pay scales, wage rises, bonuses and dismissals while we handle daily HR.

cta.label: Talk to us about HR support

blocks.heading: Hospitality Human Resources Built Around Your Leadership
paragraphs: Pay scales, yearly wage rises, bonuses and dismissals stay under your final control. Our motel human resources team works directly with your senior leadership on people strategy and performance management.

Inside the budget you approve, we set your employees' hourly rates and propose any disciplinary measures. Any salary or senior appointment outside that budget needs your approval before it goes ahead. Nobody is terminated until you or the manager you nominate signs off.

blocks.heading: Getting Started: Property Review & Handover
paragraphs: The handover, the property review and our staffing recommendations set the priorities for your people function. Once we receive your complete set of documents, your people function is fully running within 30 days.

visuals.purpose: Explain why complete documents come first and how the review leads to staffing recommendations.

items.label: Complete document handover
items.detail: Send your organisation chart, employee files and contracts, the last 12 months of payroll registers, handbook and policies, open vacancies and any collective agreement in one batch. Partial setup does not start on incomplete files.

items.label: Detailed property review
items.detail: Review the property, operations, staffing, market position and financials to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.

items.label: Staffing priorities and recommendations
items.detail: Use payroll and time records, labour cost per occupied room, overtime, turnover, occupancy forecasts and guest review scores to set staffing priorities and recommend changes.

blocks.heading: Who We Are & Which Properties Qualify

items.heading: Our company
paragraphs: We provide human resources services for motels and hotels, either on their own or as part of full management.

items.heading: Any property size
paragraphs: There's no minimum headcount for you to qualify. A 20-room motel with five staff is eligible for our HR service.

items.heading: Small-team scope
paragraphs: For a small property like yours, we concentrate on recruitment, onboarding, payroll and employment compliance, and we leave out programmes designed only for larger hotels.

items.heading: Our wider team
paragraphs: [Our team](/about-us/) is 25 people working across motel and hotel operations, revenue management and owner reporting, and they all support your property.

blocks.heading: Remote Hiring With On-Site Support
paragraphs: We recruit, place and onboard your candidates remotely, and we interview them by video. Your ownership entity stays the legal employer. We draft the offer letters and employment contracts for you to sign, and we send them out with the onboarding forms for electronic signature.

You choose a named general manager, on-site manager or local contact. That person checks original identity and right-to-work documents in person and runs any in-person final interviews or trials you ask for. On day one, they also hand out uniforms and keys and give a tour of the property. We handle every other step remotely.

blocks.heading: Your Named HR Contact, Ready to Help
paragraphs: You get one named HR contact for your motel, not a shared ticket queue. Your managers phone or email that person directly with day-to-day HR questions, and they get an answer within one business day.

items.heading: Hiring decisions and timing
paragraphs: Before we start searching, we agree your budget and how you want sign-off to work. Within that budget, we hire with your general manager, unless you want to approve hires yourself. Once the search starts, hourly roles take 14 to 21 days and management roles take 30 to 45 days.

items.heading: Candidate and contract fit
paragraphs: We screen candidates for the skills each role needs and for a personality that suits your motel. We recruit hourly, salaried and tipped employees on full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary terms.

items.heading: Departments and seasonal preparation
paragraphs: We recruit across front desk, housekeeping, maintenance, food and beverage, and management. If your property is seasonal, we start 8 weeks before opening, so your team is ready on day one.

items.heading: Training and development
paragraphs: Your front-desk team completes six structured remote video sessions within the first 30 days of working with us. We also develop and support staff retention, deliver leadership development, and provide sales and marketing training and direction.

items.heading: Replacement recruitment
paragraphs: If someone we recruited resigns or is dismissed for performance within their first 90 days, we find you a replacement with no additional recruitment fee.

items.heading: Required pre-start checks
paragraphs: Before anyone starts, we check at least two employment references, the required licences and certificates (including food-handling or first-aid credentials), and their right to work under your country’s rules. All of these checks are finished within 5 business days of the offer.

items.heading: Conditional background screening
paragraphs: Where local law permits it and your candidate consents, we arrange background checks through licensed local screening providers, and your property is billed at cost.

items.heading: Full motel management
paragraphs: With [third-party management](/), we run an independent motel’s daily operations remotely while you keep ownership. We recruit, onboard, orient and train your General Manager and Director of Sales, including brand immersion when it’s required.

blocks.heading: Full Range of HR Functions, Options & Pricing

items.heading: People programmes
items.text: Our HR lead oversees organisational design, compensation and benefits, talent acquisition and retention, cultural immersion, onboarding, training, change management, safety, risk control, and employee and labour relations.

items.heading: HR administration
items.text: We administer your payroll, benefits, policies, procedures and compliance, manage your HR technology and reporting, and provide consulting for your motel.

items.heading: Scope you choose
items.text: You buy only the modules you need. Full HR planning, executive search, recruitment, payroll, and consulting and policy projects are each available on their own. Ongoing leadership of your property team requires full management.

items.heading: Existing employment arrangements
items.text: We take on your current staff, contracts, handbook and policies as they stand, and we propose changes only after we’ve reviewed them with you.

items.heading: Unionised properties
items.text: We keep the wage, scheduling and grievance terms of your existing collective agreement, and we hold our first video meeting with union representatives within 7 days of starting.

items.heading: Management fee coverage
items.text: Under full management, your management fee covers staff leadership, recruitment and payroll processing for your team.

items.heading: Standalone service charges
items.text: For standalone recruitment, you pay per hire; for HR consulting or policy work, you pay a fixed project fee.

items.heading: Your advance quote
items.text: We give you a quote before you sign, based on your headcount, the number of hires you expect each year, the modules you select and how many properties you have.

items.heading: Staffing and shift schedules
paragraphs: We prepare departmental staffing tables, schedules, screening steps, and hiring and training guidelines, and we adjust staffing every week to match forecast occupancy. Your on-site manager publishes the rota and handles same-day swaps.

items.heading: Your system choice
paragraphs: We set up one cloud HR and payroll system for your payroll and employee records. If your existing HRIS, payroll provider and time-tracking system give us remote user access, we keep them instead.

items.heading: Monthly owner reporting
paragraphs: Each month, your owner reporting pack covers headcount, turnover, labour cost against budget, open positions, training completion and the incident log.

items.heading: Quarterly workforce review
paragraphs: Every quarter, we add a workforce review that sets out trends and our staffing recommendations for your property.

items.heading: Immediate on-site response
paragraphs: We don’t have any staff at your property. Your on-site manager or local contact handles immediate safety and calls emergency services first, then contacts your named HR contact.

items.heading: Urgent HR issues
paragraphs: Your managers report workplace injuries, harassment complaints, no-shows and sudden resignations to your named HR contact, and we reply within one business day.

items.heading: Incident records and investigation
paragraphs: We guide your incident records and your insurance or workers’ compensation filings, start harassment investigations within one business day, and help your team arrange shift cover remotely.

items.heading: Payroll across roles
paragraphs: Our [payroll service](/accounting/) covers tipped, hourly and salaried employees, distributes service charges, and pays staff who work across departments at the correct rate for each role.

items.heading: Pre-takeover compliance review
items.text: Before we take over, we go through your contracts, handbook, pay, overtime, timekeeping and required workplace notices to find any compliance gaps.

items.heading: Written findings and fixes
items.text: Within 15 business days of receiving your documents, you get our written findings with prioritised fixes, and we deal with the most serious gaps first.

items.heading: Employment law monitoring
items.text: We keep track of employment law changes in your jurisdiction, including minimum wage increases, health care rules and overtime requirements.

items.heading: Updates before implementation
items.text: When the law changes, we update the affected policies, pay rates and processes before the change takes effect, and we list every update in your monthly report.

items.heading: Local jurisdiction coverage
items.text: We cover US states, Canadian provinces, France, Australia and the other countries where we work with owners. We check your policies against the rules in your jurisdiction and confirm the requirements with local employment counsel.

items.heading: Accountable legal review
items.text: Our HR lead oversees every compliance check, and counsel licensed in your country, state or province reviews each new policy before it goes live.

hero.heading: Motel Operations Management, Remotely or On Demand
lead: We write a business plan for your motel alone, then carry it out to raise profitability.

cta.label: Talk to us about operations management

blocks.heading: A Remote Operations Management Company Built Around Your Motel
paragraphs: We build a business plan specific to your motel and carry it out, with your profitability and investment performance as its goals. Our motel operations management works as an extension of your ownership team and gives you, as a motel or hotel owner, hands-on professional support.

blocks.heading: Ownership-Aligned Business Plans and Hands-On Oversight

items.heading: Ownership-led planning
paragraphs: Your return targets drive our budget, staffing and capital decisions, not last year's budget. If a target is unrealistic for your market, we flag it during planning because it requires early reforecasting.

items.heading: Whole-property coverage
paragraphs: We provide operations management for motels and hotels remotely. That covers budgets, pricing, staffing, costs, contracts and reporting. We have no staff on site, so your teams deliver the on-site services.

items.heading: Local management contact
paragraphs: If you don't have a resident GM, we handle planning, pricing, budgets, vendors and staff leadership through the on-site lead you nominate. If your property has more than 50 rooms or has food and beverage outlets, we recommend an on-site duty manager on every shift.

items.heading: Evidence before signing
paragraphs: Before you sign, our [case studies and owner references](/case-studies/) give you calls with up to 3 current clients who have consented to speak with you. You also get anonymised RevPAR, occupancy and NOI comparisons covering the 12 months before and the 12 months after we took over.

items.heading: Existing agreement restrictions
paragraphs: We keep your SOPs and brand standards, support your department heads and follow your franchise, loan, lease and supply restrictions. Our onboarding review identifies any savings or changes those terms block, and you decide whether to keep or renegotiate those terms.

items.heading: Your business plan
paragraphs: Your plan includes a 12-month budget, a staffing model, revenue, GOP and NOI targets and a 5-year capital plan. We base it on the last 24 months of your P&L and bookings, on market and competitive-set data and on your return targets.

items.heading: Delivery and review
paragraphs: We deliver your plan within 20 business days of receiving your data and read-only system access. We review actual results with you on monthly strategy calls. When results diverge from the plan, we update forecasts quarterly, and we rebuild the plan every year.

blocks.heading: Group Purchasing Power and Supplier Savings
paragraphs: Our purchasing programmes turn our combined buying volume into supplier savings for your property. They cover the United States, Canada, France and Australia, and they also cover clients who take only revenue management or OTA management. These programmes also give you category expertise, an account manager, and compliance and risk management, with sustainability and ESG kept in view.

Before you switch, you compare our negotiated prices with your current contracts item by item and move only the categories where the savings are clear. Categories restricted by franchise-approved lists or exclusive local contracts are excluded. Suppliers outside the countries we cover are also excluded.

visuals.purpose: Explain how pooled purchasing produces savings that go to the property.
visuals.caption: From pooled purchasing to owner savings.

items.label: Pool purchasing volume
items.detail: We pool your orders with other clients' through our group purchasing programme.

items.label: Secure better pricing
items.detail: We use a group purchasing programme to secure better commodity pricing.

items.label: Pass savings to you
items.detail: Orders are placed in your property's name and the negotiated savings are passed to you in full.

blocks.heading: How Remote Third-Party Operations Work for Your Property

items.heading: Remote daily oversight
paragraphs: We direct guest service and finances through shared systems, reporting and scheduled calls, and your staff carry out the decisions on site. You get consistent standards and financial control without a resident management team.

items.heading: Operational fit
paragraphs: Remote management requires a reliable on-site contact and up-to-date systems. It works best for properties that don't have complex daily on-site operations.

items.heading: Management agreement terms
paragraphs: Under [motel management](/), you keep ownership and pay either 3% to 5% of revenue or a fixed fee based on your room count. You can also choose to add 10% of GOP above budget. If we miss the RevPAR-index or GOP targets for 2 consecutive quarters, you can exit without a fee on 30 days’ notice.

items.heading: Lead time for a switch
paragraphs: If you're changing management, bring us in 6 to 8 weeks before the handover date. That window lets us carry out a pre-transition analysis, get logins for your PMS, extranets and channel manager, and go through your vendor contracts.

items.heading: Independent asset oversight
paragraphs: Our [asset management](/asset-management/) oversees your operations, renovations and operators using read-only PMS and accounting access, weekly operator reports and scheduled video walkthroughs. When needed, we commission independent local inspections, and we review the reports with you within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Your Accounts and How You Can Leave

items.heading: Owner-held accounts
items.text: From day one, every login, account and data record is in your ownership entity's name, so you can leave without needing our consent.

items.heading: Administrative responsibility
items.text: Because you hold the accounts, you handle administrative tasks that a manager would otherwise handle, such as vendor billing contacts and access renewals.

items.heading: Orderly handover
items.text: When our agreement ends, we return your booking, guest and financial records, logins and accounts intact. Your operations keep running while everything transfers to you or your next operator.

items.heading: Recruitment and development
paragraphs: Our [human resources support](/human-resources/) covers hiring, training and keeping your motel's staff.

items.heading: Payroll records and corrections
paragraphs: For [payroll processing](/accounting/), you submit department-approved time records and tip, service-charge or pay-rate changes by noon on the second business day after each pay period. We pay undisputed hours on schedule and flag gaps. We correct missing or disputed records in the next run.

paragraphs: Your ownership entity holds the operating licences, permits, property insurance and general liability insurance. Because you hold the licences and cover, they stay valid when operators change. Renewing on time prevents lapses that close outlets or void cover.
We carry professional liability and errors and omissions cover, and we add you as an additional insured if you ask.

For [pre-opening readiness](/development/), you provide the completed building works, the opening-budget funding and your appointed local team or general manager. We help you obtain all required licences, including occupational, liquor and health department licences.

paragraphs: We assess how your property runs today using benchmarking, reporting and technology for upgrading your systems.

steps.heading: Share operating records
steps.text: You give us read-only access to 12 months of P&L statements, PMS reports, payroll and timekeeping records, maintenance and work-order logs, and guest reviews and complaint logs, along with your current vendor contracts.

steps.heading: Rebuild missing baselines
steps.text: If your labour, maintenance or guest-service records are incomplete, the assessment still goes ahead. We rebuild baselines from payroll exports, vendor invoices and online reviews. We mark the less precise findings as estimates that show direction, not exact figures.

steps.heading: Assessment fee
steps.text: You pay a fixed assessment fee. It rises with your room count, your revenue outlets and the number of systems we connect beyond your PMS and channel manager. Rebuilding missing records also raises the fee.

steps.heading: Extra scope
steps.text: Analysing more than 3 years of history costs more, and so does reviewing several properties together. If your hotel has more than 200 rooms, you get a custom quote.

steps.heading: Establish complete tracking
steps.text: We don't hold back the assessment until your records are perfect. Instead, we set up tracking while we diagnose, which gives you 90 days of complete data for the follow-up review.

steps.heading: Identify recovery priorities
steps.text: Our recovery diagnosis examines your financial health, market position, physical condition and operating performance. We trace revenue, cost, staffing and brand-compliance problems to their causes. Then we define corrections and repositioning opportunities specific to your property.

items.heading: Property-specific improvements
paragraphs: We use your operational data to design improvements and new revenue streams for your motel. We benchmark your costs against comparable properties and keep within your capital spending limit.

items.heading: No-capital changes first
paragraphs: We make labour scheduling changes, procurement savings, rate and channel adjustments, and sales and marketing fixes before any capital projects. That way, the straightforward improvements don't depend on major investment decisions.

items.heading: Capital approval choices
paragraphs: For each capital item, we show you the cost, the timing and the effect on future cash flow, and you decide whether to approve, defer or drop it. If a deferral lets wear or competitive gaps build up, it raises your costs later.

items.heading: Daily revenue measures
paragraphs: Every business day, we track your rate, occupancy and RevPAR against your competitive set, along with RevPAR index, ADR, booking pace and channel costs. We report these against your approved budget.

items.heading: Operating performance measures
paragraphs: We also report your GOP margin, departmental cost ratios, labour cost per occupied room, NOI and cash flow against your approved budget.

items.heading: Technology and provider oversight
paragraphs: Our [property-specific IT services](/information-technology/) cover cloud platforms, payment processing, telecommunications, monitoring, managed services, and cyber and privacy compliance. blocks.heading: Outsourced motel revenue management, run remotely for your property
paragraphs: We run day-to-day motel revenue management remotely, for your motel or small hotel. That covers pricing, forecasting, distribution and ad-hoc group quotations. We tailor the service to your property and scale it as your needs grow. You can choose one of three plans or a customised offer.

blocks.heading: Three plans for how much you want to hand off
paragraphs: We build our plans around how much strategic scope and direct contact you want. They don't differ in how often daily pricing happens.
rows: Base
One strategy call a month, and you can book extra meetings.
Extended

blocks.heading: Dynamic pricing connected to the PMS you already use
paragraphs: Before you sign, we check that your PMS supports two-way rate integration. That way, prices reach your channels without anyone re-entering them by hand. We work with Mews, Cloudbeds, Opera Cloud, RoomRaccoon and most other systems that support rate integration. If your system isn't on that list, send us its name and we'll confirm whether it qualifies.

blocks.heading: We set and adjust your room rates every business day

items.heading: Daily pricing decisions
paragraphs: Your dedicated revenue manager sets your room rates every business day; on weekends and public holidays, your rates follow the pricing rules we set with you. items.heading: Approved price boundaries
paragraphs: Before we change any prices, we agree with you on a fixed minimum for each room type and a ceiling for peak demand. We then build those limits into your pricing rules.

items.heading: Daily movement caps
paragraphs: You can also cap how much your rates move in a single day, for example at 15%. We only price within the limits you've approved, and you can change them whenever you like.

items.heading: Limited property portfolios
paragraphs: Each dedicated revenue manager looks after no more than 12 properties at a time, so your motel gets attention every business day.

items.heading: Continuous market checks
paragraphs: Every business day, we compare your rates with up to 10 similar properties nearby, review your pricing and calendars and track your market and competitors.

items.heading: Hours and time zones
paragraphs: Your named manager responds during our business hours, Monday to Friday on Eastern Time. We schedule sessions and reviews in your property's time zone, whether you're in Australia, Europe or North America.

items.heading: Uninterrupted coverage
paragraphs: When your manager is away, another revenue manager who already knows your property covers for them.

blocks.heading: Demand forecasts that become budgets and targets
paragraphs: We turn your demand forecasts into rooms revenue budgets and business targets, and we revalidate them on a rolling basis. You get owner-ready demand forecasts, booking pace reports and annual revenue budgets. Your forecasts are validated for the current month plus three months and for the current month plus six months. On the Complete plan, we also convert the forecast into a 12-month pricing calendar.

paragraphs: We structure your channel rate plans, weighting and differentials to build visibility and protect your average rates. This prevents cannibalisation, ranking damage and prices below your direct rate, and it keeps direct booking the best value.

mainEntity.name: How do a one-off project and ongoing managed IT differ in later maintenance, the staff time the owner must put in and assurance that the systems stay available?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fixed-scope project covers design, build and testing, and after handover your team and vendors operate and maintain what we delivered. Managed IT suits motels with no in-house IT staff or several connected systems, while a project suits you if a capable team or vendor will take over.

mainEntity.name: For cabling, network equipment installation or hardware replacement, which on-site people do I need to arrange, and which remote guidance and acceptance work do you handle?

mainEntity.name: When systems are replaced, how do you migrate and reconcile existing reservations and guest data, and how do you restore normal operations if the switchover fails?

acceptedAnswer.text: We export future reservations, guest profiles and rate data from your old system, import them into the new one, reconcile record counts and totals, and check at least 50 reservations line by line. Your old system stays ready until the reconciliation and acceptance tests pass, and if the cutover fails, we use the tested rollback to restore your original setup within the 4-hour offline window.

items.heading: Switchover rollback

items.heading: Managed configuration and faults

items.heading: Managed security controls
items.text: On the motel devices and accounts covered by managed IT, we maintain multi-factor authentication, role-based permissions and centralised endpoint protection.

items.heading: Vendor security responsibilities

items.heading: Your account approvals
items.text: You approve new user accounts and tell us when staff leave. When you tell us, we remove their access.

items.heading: Our system access

items.heading: Access oversight

items.heading: Privacy and data hosting

Your budget covers hard construction costs; architect, engineer and consultant fees; permits and connections; FF&E, OS&E and IT; pre-opening costs; and construction-period financing.

We set aside 10% of hard costs for new builds and 15% for renovations at operating motels. No draw happens without your prior written approval.

We give you both at appointment and track performance against them throughout. When a budget line is forecast to exceed its allowance by more than 5%, we flag it for your approval.
Monthly reporting

You get a written cost report, a dashboard and a monthly owner report. Together they show approved budgets, signed-contract and purchase-order commitments, actual spending, forecast cost to complete and the funding still required. You can also view the dashboard live.
Cost accountability
We track committed, forecast and contingency costs by budget line, programme and property, and we link every cost change to the decision behind it.
Progress reporting
Our reports cover schedule progress, critical-path milestones, open risks and every approved or pending scope change. Between monthly reports, we send you a short weekly progress email.
Closeout documents
You receive PDFs of the as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, guarantees, contractor final releases, final cost reconciliation and the completed punch list.

items.heading: Payment controls
paragraphs: We handle draw requests, payments and lien waivers. We check each draw against its contract, the completed-work sign-off and the waivers. We release payment from your account only after you give final approval.

items.heading: Cost and delivery trade-offs
paragraphs: We help you weigh change orders, value engineering and accelerated schedules against their effect on your renovation's cost, quality and completion.

hero.heading: Motel Development Managed From Site to Opening
lead: We coordinate design, construction and technical services so your motel meets brand standards before opening.

blocks.heading: A Motel Development Company With One Point of Coordination
paragraphs: You deal with your motel brand through a single point of coordination: we handle brand submittals and approvals remotely and coordinate the design and construction your architect and contractor carry out. Our motel development support also covers purchasing, handled through a buying group set up specifically for this work.

blocks.heading: Brand Submittals and Design Change Control
paragraphs: We handle every brand submittal and approval remotely through your brand’s portal, using the access you give us. Each brand has its own documentation requirements, so we build every package to the current requirements of the brand you’ve selected. Our change-control process sets out the costs and compliant alternatives before you commit any additional funds.

visuals.purpose: Explain how a new requirement or design change is assessed before extra cost is committed.
visuals.caption: Budget impact and compliant alternatives before commitment.

items.label: Requirement or change arises
items.detail: The brand issues a new requirement or someone proposes a design change.

items.label: Calculate budget impact
items.detail: We calculate the effect on your development budget within 5 business days.

items.label: Present compliant alternatives
items.detail: We give you at least 2 compliant alternatives before any extra cost is committed.

items.label: Submit for brand approval
items.detail: If an alternative needs brand approval, we submit it to the brand for you.

blocks.heading: Remote Motel and Hotel Development, From Site to Opening
paragraphs: We serve development projects in the United States, Canada, France and Australia. Our team stays with you from early development through to operations.
Under our [remote service model](/our-process/), we have no on-site staff at your property.

visuals.purpose: Show when to involve the remote team and how its involvement continues into hotel operations.
visuals.caption: The same remote team from early development into operations.

items.label: Early involvement
items.detail: Ideally appoint us before buying land or signing a franchise agreement so we can shape the design and brand terms.

items.label: Design and construction
items.detail: Our remote team provides brand coordination and procurement during development.

items.label: Pre-opening work
items.detail: The same team carries development work into pre-opening.

items.label: Day-to-day management
items.detail: The same team continues into operations, with all services run remotely and no on-site staff.

blocks.heading: Flexible Buying Routes and Transparent Fees
paragraphs: Choose brand coordination only, procurement only or full development oversight; none requires a management agreement afterwards. Your fee is based on scope, the stage at which you appoint us, duration in months and number of purchase packages, not your FF&E budget. If a submittal needs more than 2 brand revision rounds, or you need accelerated purchasing, we quote that as an addition before work starts.

visuals.purpose: Show that all engagement options are available without a subsequent management agreement or a fee linked to FF&E budget size.
visuals.caption: Choose your scope without committing to ongoing management.

blocks.heading: FF&E Quote Comparison and Value Engineering
paragraphs: When we compare your FF&E and OS&E quotes, we look at delivered value, how well each one meets the specification and how reliable the supplier is, not just the unit price. Our comparison and value-engineering process protects your design quality, and every substitution still needs brand approval.

visuals.purpose: Explain the checks and approval gates between receiving a quotation and ordering a substitute.
visuals.caption: Compare delivered value and approve substitutes before ordering.

items.label: Compare quotations
items.detail: Check brand specifications, shop drawings and samples, supplier lead time and delivery record, and total delivered cost including freight, duties and installation.

items.label: Value engineer if needed
items.detail: Where a quote exceeds budget, propose equivalent products that reduce cost without lowering design quality.

items.label: Obtain brand approval
items.detail: Put any substitute to the brand for approval before the order is placed.

items.label: Place the order
items.detail: Order the substitute only after brand approval.

blocks.heading: Purchasing File Handover to Your Opening Team
paragraphs: We give your opening team the purchase orders, invoices, receiving records, warranties and supplier contacts. We also give them a log that shows who is responsible for each open brand or supplier issue and the deadline for it. If another operator is involved, they get the same package and a 60-minute handover call within 10 business days of final delivery.

items.heading: Drawing reviews
paragraphs: We check every drawing set against brand standards and your operating plan, and we send you our comments within 5 business days.

items.heading: Architect responsibilities
paragraphs: Your architect keeps their contract with you. They stay responsible for site inspections and for signing off completed work.

items.heading: Approval preparation
paragraphs: Within 10 business days of receiving your project documents, we prepare your licensing, permitting, zoning and brand approval applications, drawing packages and timelines remotely.

items.heading: Local representation
paragraphs: When a filing, hearing or inspection has to be done in person, including for operating and liquor licences, we appoint a local licensed permit agent or planner and direct their work.

items.heading: Company and licensing
paragraphs: Under our [company arrangements](/about-us/), your operating licences and permits stay in your name and on-site work goes to partners or local contractors. Before you sign, we tell you about any local registration requirements. Our Canadian corporate registration details are available on request.

items.heading: Existing project takeover
paragraphs: If your project is already underway, our [project management](/project-management/) keeps your appointed team and commitments in place while we review it. Within 10 business days of receiving your documents, we send you a written report on the project's status, its gaps and how to recover. Any change needs your approval.

blocks.heading: Procurement, Brand Representation and Standalone Development Services

items.heading: Purchasing coverage
paragraphs: We source all of your FF&E, or only the packages you choose, through your suppliers or brand-approved vendors. We represent you with the brand on every purchasing decision.

items.heading: Separate assignments
paragraphs: You can hire us for deal sourcing, brand selection or pre-opening support on its own, or as the first phase of a management agreement.

items.heading: Imported furnishings
paragraphs: We appoint and coordinate a licensed customs broker, prepare the commercial invoices, packing lists and certificates of origin, and track customs clearance. For each order, we agree whether your company is the importer of record or the supplier is, under delivered-duty-paid terms.

items.heading: Investment support
paragraphs: Our [business development services](/business-development/) look at your investment from an owner's point of view and support it from deal sourcing through to help with valuation and due diligence.

items.heading: Brand representation
paragraphs: Through [asset management](/asset-management/), we act for you remotely on franchise applications, PIP negotiations, standards reviews and fee audits. We don't hold approved or preferred operator status.

items.heading: Motel technology
paragraphs: We provide [turnkey IT](/information-technology/) project management for your motel technology projects, including those that are part of a new development.

blocks.heading: FF&E Delivery, Lead Times and Quality Control

items.heading: Long-lead items
items.text: Our [project management](/project-management/) flags long-lead FF&E, tracks it against your opening date and handles late items, substitutes and fallbacks.

items.heading: Delivery checks
items.text: For every delivery, we check the receiving reports and photos from your on-site team against the approved purchase order.

items.heading: Claims and warranties
items.text: We file damage and shortage claims with suppliers or carriers, arrange replacements and follow every warranty issue through until it's resolved.

blocks.heading: Owner Time, Fixed Fees and Independent Advice

items.heading: Your weekly time
items.text: You'll spend about 2 to 4 hours a week. That includes a 30-minute video update each week and the sign-offs we need from you.

items.heading: Decision authority
items.text: You name one contact and set a purchase approval limit. You approve brand submittals, budget changes and any order above that limit, and we handle the correspondence and supplier follow-up.

items.heading: Opening prerequisites
items.text: You provide the completed building works, the funding for the opening budget, and an on-site team or general manager that you appoint.

items.heading: Operating licences
items.text: We help you get every licence you need to open and trade, including occupational, liquor and health department licences.

items.heading: Agreed pricing
items.text: Before you sign, we quote you a fixed fee or a monthly retainer, not a percentage of your pre-opening budget.

items.heading: Direct supplier contracts
items.text: Suppliers contract directly with your ownership entity at their own prices. We don't resell anything, we add no mark-up and we take nothing from what you spend.

items.heading: Independent recommendations
items.text: We don't accept referral fees or commissions from franchisors, lenders or FF&E suppliers. Your fees are the only thing that pays for our advice, so it's based on what fits your motel.

items.heading: Custom quotations
items.text: For hotels with more than 200 rooms, luxury properties and multi-property groups, we prepare a [custom quote](/request-a-quote/).

items.heading: Your motel team
paragraphs: Our [human resources support](/human-resources/) can staff your new property and train its team before opening.

items.heading: Opening programme
paragraphs: We coordinate hiring, training, system setup, sales ramp-up and launch as one programme, adapted to your brand's standards or your independent positioning.

items.heading: Management preparation
paragraphs: Our [motel management programme](/) covers the core pre-opening work over the 3 to 6 months before you open, with your budget approval and monthly progress reports. After that, for independent motels and hotels, we manage the property remotely while you keep ownership.

items.heading: Daily operations
paragraphs: Our [operations management](/operations-management/) oversees the day-to-day running of your property, covering guest services, the overall guest experience and financial management.

seo.title: Motel Asset Management & Owner Performance Reviews | MotelPilot
seo.description: Protect owner value with motel asset management: an initial performance review, hands-on revenue and capex control, and distressed work-out support.

hero.heading: Motel Asset Management for Branded and Independent Owners
lead: We weigh every operating decision at your motel against your financial targets, day to day.

cta.label: Talk to us about asset management

blocks.heading: An Asset Management Company That Maximises Owner Value
paragraphs: Our job in motel asset management is to lift your motel's revenue and cost performance so the property earns you the highest possible yield. Our asset management also takes on under-performing properties and turns their performance around.

Day to day, we weigh operations against your financial targets. We use market intelligence, structured analysis and industry practice to keep each decision in line with your objectives and to put your investment where it earns the best return.

blocks.heading: Representing You With Brands and Operators

items.heading: Owner profit first
paragraphs: We judge every operator decision by what it does to your profit and cash flow, not by revenue or brand standards alone. This holds brands accountable and closes the trust gap between you and your operator.

items.heading: Independent motel expertise
paragraphs: If your motel or small hotel is unbranded or independently run, we work closely on its operations and supply the expertise your property lacks.

items.heading: Your chosen team
paragraphs: We represent you day to day with the operator you choose, including third-party operators, or with your own management team. We improve those relationships and agree practical fixes with them.

blocks.heading: Using Your Approval Rights With Your Operator
paragraphs: As your appointed representative, we get our authority from the approval rights in your management or franchise agreement, not from your operator's goodwill. We use those rights to review proposals, and we settle challenges with evidence and contractual escalation.

visuals.purpose: Explain how contractual approval rights support reviews and escalation while the owner retains final approval.
visuals.caption: Review, challenge and escalation under your existing agreement.

items.label: Review and recommend
items.detail: As your appointed representative, we review operator budgets and capital plans, recommend whether to sign them off, and join owner meetings and monthly operations reviews by video. You keep final approval.

items.label: Review operator pushback
items.detail: If the operator pushes back on our findings, we go through the data with them in a joint review within 10 business days.

items.label: Recommend contractual action
items.detail: If the issue remains open after the joint review, we send you a written recommendation on using the performance and dispute terms in your agreement.

blocks.heading: Properties of Every Size, Overseen Remotely

items.heading: No size threshold
paragraphs: Our asset management for motels and hotels takes on properties of any size. You don't need a minimum room count, revenue or asset value to work with us.

items.heading: Smaller property scope
paragraphs: For a smaller motel, we concentrate on quarterly property evaluations, an annual capital plan and monthly reviews of profitability against your financial goals.

items.heading: Remote operational access
paragraphs: We oversee operations, renovations and your operator remotely, using read access to your PMS and accounting systems, weekly reports from the operator and scheduled video walkthroughs.

items.heading: Independent local inspections
paragraphs: When a property needs an in-person inspection, we hire an independent local inspector or engineer and go through their report with you within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Our Track Record and Owner References
paragraphs: We've operated since 2016 and today provide management or revenue management for 60 motels and hotels. Read more in our [company background](/about-us/).

Before you sign, we'll arrange calls with up to 3 current owner clients and share anonymised RevPAR, occupancy and NOI comparisons for the 12 months before and after we took over. See our [performance evidence and owner references](/case-studies/).

items.heading: Data and timing
paragraphs: The review takes 4 to 6 weeks from kick-off to written recommendations. It starts once we have your last 24 months of P&Ls, your STR or benchmark reports, read-only access to your PMS and your management agreement.

items.heading: Independent diagnostic work
paragraphs: We carry out operational assessments and detailed benchmarking to find opportunities and give you detailed recommendations.

items.heading: Commercial review scope
paragraphs: This one-time review looks at market segmentation, positioning, strategy, the competitive landscape, market intelligence, revenue management strategy and marketing.

items.heading: Operational review scope
paragraphs: We go through departmental expenses, staffing, HR practices, operating processes and guest service to find where your motel's performance needs to improve.

items.heading: Quantified action priorities
paragraphs: Where your data supports an estimate, we put a number on the effect on revenue, GOP or cash flow. We then rank the recommendations in an 80/20 action plan by expected impact, urgency and the effort needed to implement them.

items.heading: Your implementation plan
paragraphs: Every recommendation comes with a priority, a responsible owner and a timeline. We take your team through it in a 60-minute walkthrough, and you or your operator can then implement the plan on your own.

items.heading: Optional delivery support
paragraphs: The review stands on its own. If you want help implementing it later, you can engage us for ongoing asset management, owner-side operator oversight or a specific follow-on project.

items.heading: Written scope and fees
paragraphs: You pay a one-time fixed fee for the review and for any follow-on project, and ongoing asset management is billed as a monthly retainer. We put the scope and the fees that apply in writing before any work starts.

blocks.heading: Hands-On Ongoing Motel Asset Management Services

items.heading: Strategy into action
items.text: We put the strategic review into practice by repositioning and resetting your asset, budgeting revenue and improving market segmentation.

items.heading: Commercial performance oversight
items.text: We oversee your sales, marketing and revenue strategy, run ongoing operational and commercial reviews, and analyse your competitive set.

items.heading: Operating efficiency improvements
items.text: We optimise departmental expenses, staff allocation, internal processes, cash flow and working capital. We also review debtor management and purchasing and benchmark your cost KPIs.

items.heading: Financial and capital controls
items.text: We negotiate annual budgets, prepare P&L and cash flow forecasts, prepare and monitor CapEx budgets, and keep FF&E accounting and spending under control.

items.heading: Annual budget scenarios
items.text: We set your annual budget on the realistic case of a 12-month forecast run under conservative, realistic and optimistic scenarios, and use the other two cases to plan staffing, spending and pricing.

items.heading: Clearly attributed results
items.text: Every report compares your results with your competitive set, showing what came from market demand and what came from your motel outperforming it. We also separate the areas affected by capital work from the rest of the operation, which shows you the gains from a renovation.

items.heading: Forward revenue intelligence
items.text: Our [revenue management](/revenue-management/) reviews 12 months of pace every week and demand every business day. It also forecasts the current month and three and six months ahead, reviews intelligence every month and reviews rolling 12-month group rates every quarter.

items.heading: Capital project delivery
items.text: Our turnkey [project management](/project-management/) handles procurement, new builds, conversions, renovations, PIPs, building systems, 5-year budgeted capital and emergency capital, and coordinates the technical design and construction your contractors carry out, keeping disruption to your business to a minimum.

items.heading: Reviewed financial reporting
items.text: Through our [accounting service](/accounting/), you get P&Ls reviewed by a staff accountant and a licensed CPA within 10 business days of month-end. You also get cash flow statements and prompt reconciliations of cash, assets and liabilities.

items.heading: Choosing the right scope
paragraphs: Choose owner-side oversight when you trust your operator to implement our recommendations, because the results depend on your operator acting on them. With full asset management, we deliver the plans ourselves and measure the RevPAR and GOP effect, though results aren't guaranteed.

items.heading: Strategy and operating analysis
paragraphs: We review positioning, strategy, revenue budgets and forecasts, plan capital and investment, and evaluate internal processes and detailed internal data against industry benchmarks.

items.heading: Owner investment advice
paragraphs: We advise you on franchise affiliation, management contract terms, budgets, capital investment and whether to buy, hold or sell, and we monitor how the asset is performing.

items.heading: Limited owner time
paragraphs: Your part is a monthly report review and strategy call, plus any budget and capital decisions that need your approval.

items.heading: Monthly operator accountability
paragraphs: Each month you get a report and a review meeting with your operator's operations team, covering revenue against budget and forecast, capital planning and open issues.

items.heading: Budget and valuation reviews
paragraphs: Every year, we give you a written critique of the operator's proposed budget before you approve it. Every quarter, we update the estimate of your asset's value using NOI and cap rate trends.

items.heading: Market terms comparison
items.text: We compare your management contract or lease with current market terms and assess how suitable and effective your current operator is.

items.heading: Commercial provision testing
items.text: We test the base and incentive fees, performance clauses, term, termination rights and your obligations as owner, including reserves and funding calls.

items.heading: Owner commercial representation
items.text: We represent you when you renegotiate fees, performance clauses and contract term with your operator.

items.heading: Your counsel's role
items.text: We don't give legal advice. Your counsel checks the enforceability, liability and indemnity wording, then drafts and finalises the amendments that address our commercial findings.

items.heading: Operator exit assessment
items.text: If leaving is the better option, we assess your termination rights and exit costs and build your case from the performance-test results.

items.heading: Planned operator transition
items.text: If you choose to change operator, we plan a 90-day transition to the incoming operator.

items.heading: Standalone project engagement
items.text: You can commission a contract or lease review and renegotiation, or a buy, hold or sell analysis, without a management agreement.

blocks.heading: Related Services for Motel and Hotel Owners

items.heading: Development support
items.text: During planning and development, our [development service](/development/) negotiates for you and brings global product and programming insight, so the product stays in balance with its budget.

items.heading: Investment acquisition support
items.text: Our [business development service](/business-development/) helps with deal sourcing, valuation and diligence, using proven methods and an owner's perspective.

items.heading: Independent motel management
items.text: Our [third-party motel management](/) runs the day-to-day operations of your independent motel, and you keep ownership of the property.

items.heading: Services without management
items.text: Our [standalone capabilities](/capabilities/), including asset management, need no management agreement or long-term contract. You need a full management agreement only for ongoing leadership of your motel staff.

items.heading: Outsourced OTA support
items.text: Our [OTA management](/ota-optimization/) covers Booking.com and Expedia. Outsourced revenue management is available on its own or alongside motel management.

items.heading: Purchasing cost savings
items.text: Our [operations management](/operations-management/) pools purchasing volume through a group purchasing programme to get better commodity pricing, and we pass the savings on to you.

items.heading: Motel team development
items.text: Our [human resources support](/human-resources/) helps you build and keep a stronger motel team.

items.heading: Remote service model
items.text: Our [working process](/our-process/) is fully remote for every service. We have no on-site staff at any property.

items.heading: Turnaround implementation
paragraphs: To put the plan into action, we audit sales and marketing, analyse the market and competitive set, reposition the asset, benchmark costs, work out CapEx needs and timing, and provide hands-on asset management.

items.heading: Cash survival first
paragraphs: Within the first 10 business days of our remote diagnostic, we build a 13-week cash flow model. It shows the minimum trading cash you need for payroll, utilities, debt service and critical vendors. Only after that do we move on to repositioning or a longer-term turnaround.

items.heading: Written funding assessment
paragraphs: We tell you in writing whether recovery is feasible without more owner funding, or exactly how much extra funding is needed and when.

items.heading: Independent recovery planning
paragraphs: To build a turnaround or work-out plan, we check business plans, carry out independent business reviews, review the finances and model future cash flow.

items.question: What actual authority do you have over my operator or brand, and what happens when the operator pushes back on your findings?
items.answer: Our authority as your appointed representative comes from the approval rights in your management or franchise agreement, not from your operator's goodwill. We use those rights when reviewing proposals, and when the operator pushes back, we resolve it with evidence and contractual escalation.

items.question: How many weeks does the performance review take from kick-off to recommendations, and which data do I need to provide?
items.answer: From kick-off to written recommendations, the review takes 4 to 6 weeks. To start, we need your last 24 months of P&Ls, your STR or benchmark reports, read-only access to your PMS and your management agreement.

items.question: After the review, can I implement the plan myself, and can I buy the review on its own?
items.answer: Yes. The review stands on its own for a one-time fixed fee, and every recommendation comes with a priority, a responsible owner and a timeline. After a 60-minute walkthrough, you or your operator can implement the plan yourselves, or engage us later for ongoing asset management, owner-side operator oversight or a specific follow-on project.

items.question: Can I engage you only for a single decision, such as renegotiating my management contract or a buy/hold/sell analysis, rather than ongoing representation?
items.answer: Yes. A contract or lease review and renegotiation, or a buy, hold or sell analysis, can be commissioned as a standalone project without a management agreement. For a renegotiation, we test your fees, performance clauses, term and owner obligations and represent you with your operator, while your counsel drafts and finalises the amendments.

items.question: Before we commit to a turnaround, will you identify the minimum cash needed to keep trading and whether recovery is feasible without additional owner funding?
items.answer: Yes. Within the first 10 business days of our remote diagnostic, we build a 13-week cash flow model showing the minimum trading cash you need for payroll, utilities, debt service and critical vendors. We then tell you in writing whether recovery is feasible without more owner funding, or exactly how much extra funding is needed and when.

seo.title: Motel Accounting Services with USALI Owner Reporting | MotelPilot
seo.description: From daily income audits to USALI reporting with variance analysis, our motel accounting handles tax, payroll and banking for your motel or hotel.

hero.heading: Motel Accounting and Owner Reporting Services
lead: You see your motel's financial results clearly and on schedule, without chasing anyone for numbers.

blocks.heading: Accurate Numbers, Delivered on Time
paragraphs: Our motel accounting and owner reporting services get you accurate financial analytics, on time. Our owner reporting and accounting lead answers for the financial results of every motel and hotel we manage and holds each report to the same standards for accuracy and delivery.

items.heading: Departmental results first
paragraphs: Your monthly P&L comes in USALI departmental format. You see rooms, any food and beverage, and every other operated department on its own before any shared costs are allocated.

items.heading: Allocated overheads
paragraphs: We also spread shared administration, sales and marketing, utilities and maintenance costs across departments by revenue share or floor area.

items.heading: Variance explanations
paragraphs: We compare every line with budget and with the prior year. Your monthly and year-end reporting package explains every variance of more than 5%.

items.heading: Performance comparisons
paragraphs: Your package includes a budget-versus-actual variance report. It also compares occupancy, ADR and RevPAR against budget, last year's results and your competitive set.

items.heading: Required accounting framework
paragraphs: We work in the framework your lenders and tax filings require: US GAAP, IFRS or the applicable local standard in Canada, France or Australia.

items.heading: Consolidated ownership reporting
paragraphs: We report by motel, by legal entity and for the consolidated group. On consolidation we eliminate intercompany balances and internal markups, and each property keeps its own P&L.

blocks.heading: Ways to Engage Our Accounting Services

items.heading: Switch when needed
items.text: You don't have to wait for fiscal year-end. We take over at any point, starting from your previous accountant's trial balance, general ledger and latest reconciliations.

items.heading: Backlog cleanup
items.text: Before your first full monthly report, we reconcile up to the past 12 months. Our target is to finish that within 30 business days.

items.heading: Named accounting contact
items.text: You deal day to day with a named staff accountant who looks after no more than 8 properties.

items.heading: Questions answered promptly
items.text: Your designated accounting contact answers your accounting questions within one business day.

items.heading: Your data ownership
items.text: Your accounting data is yours, both during our engagement and after it ends.

items.heading: Complete exit handover
items.text: When you leave, you get your full general ledger, vendor files, supporting documents and reports within 10 business days, exported in Excel, CSV and PDF.

items.heading: Standalone service options
items.text: Our [standalone services](/capabilities/), including accounting and asset management, need no management agreement and no long-term contract. Ongoing leadership of your motel staff requires full management.

items.heading: Daily financial priorities
paragraphs: Every business day, precise income auditing, receivables collection and cash balancing come first. We check every line item twice before any figures move forward.

items.heading: Finance function coverage
paragraphs: Our team takes care of treasury, accounts payable, fixed asset accounting, internal audits, guidance on third-party audits and support for your joint ventures.

items.heading: Payroll across roles
paragraphs: We pay your tipped, hourly and salaried employees and distribute service charges. When staff work across departments, we apply the correct rate for each role.

items.heading: Banking and controls
paragraphs: Working in your accounts, our remote team handles reduced-fee ACH, bank checks against approved payment records, electronic bank reconciliation, card and payment processing, bank-account setup and upkeep, insurance purchasing support, financial audits and an annual internal control audit.

Our [privacy and payment safeguards](/privacy-policy/) follow Canada's PIPEDA, the GDPR for French properties, the Australian Privacy Act and relevant US state laws. Card data stays outside our systems because we use PCI DSS-compliant processors. We provide Canadian cloud hosting, and on request we store data for French properties in the EU.
